Windows to Omarchy: shortcuts

Windows shortcuts, translated

Keep your Windows key. Most habits move over in a day.

Reviewed 2026-10-21 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

On Omarchy the Windows key is called Super and it does most of the work. Super+Space replaces the Start menu, Print Screen replaces Win+Shift+S, Super+Ctrl+V replaces Win+V, and Super+W closes a window like Alt+F4. Super+K shows every hotkey, so it is the only one you need to memorize.

The translation table

On Windows you pressOn Omarchy pressWhat happens
Windows key (Start)Super + SpaceOmarchy menu: apps, settings, install, capture. Type to filter.
Start, apps onlySuper + Alt + SpaceApps-only menu
Win + Shift + SPrint ScreenScreenshot with markup tools (Omasnap)
Win + VSuper + Ctrl + VClipboard history, images included
Ctrl + C / VSuper + C / X / VCopy, cut, paste everywhere, terminal included
Alt + F4Super + W (or Super + Q)Close the window. The app really quits.
Win + LSuper + Ctrl + LLock the computer
Virtual desktopsSuper + 1 to 4Jump to a workspace. Add Shift to move the window there.
Alt + TabAlt + TabCycle windows on the current workspace
Snap to half screenNothing to pressWindows tile on their own. Super + T floats one.
Notification centerSuper + Shift + Alt + ,Notification history
Control PanelSetup in the Omarchy menuOpens the right config file and restarts what needs it
Power menuSuper + EscapeSuspend, restart, shut down

Three keys that behave differently

  • Ctrl + Alt + Del closes all windows on Omarchy. It is not a task manager. Save first.
  • Caps Lock is a compose key for quick emoji and symbols. If you want Caps Lock back, set kb_options = "compose:ralt" in ~/.config/hypr/input.lua (Setup, then Input, in the menu).
  • Quick panels live on Super + Ctrl + A (audio), B (Bluetooth) and W (Wi-Fi).

Animation frame from the omacom/omasnap README (MIT).

How to learn the rest in two weeks

The Omarchy manual's advice for switchers is to give it two weeks. Skim the hotkeys once, and whenever you blank, press Super + K to see every binding. If the Windows key is awkward on your keyboard, the manual shows how to swap Alt and Super with altwin:swap_alt_win.

Frequently asked questions

What is the Super key on Omarchy?

It is the Windows key on a PC keyboard, and the Command key on a Mac. Nearly every Omarchy hotkey starts with it.

What replaces the Windows Start menu?

Super+Space opens the Omarchy menu, which launches apps, opens settings and installs software. Start typing to filter.

How do I take a screenshot like Win+Shift+S?

Press Print Screen. Omasnap opens so you can select an area and add arrows, text or blur.

Where is clipboard history like Win+V?

Super+Ctrl+V. It holds images as well as text.

How do I see all the keyboard shortcuts?

Press Super+K. It lists every binding Omarchy has set up.

What does Ctrl+Alt+Del do on Omarchy?

It closes all windows. Use Super+Escape for the power menu instead.
